title: Brand spec to page map, REST API and responsive page
what: Turns a synthetic brand spec into a page list and component map, serves it through REST routes, and renders one responsive home page from components.
shows: Written scope files, validated API responses including contact form errors, and a responsive page that works at phone and desktop widths.
checks: component count matches computed two ways
every home component rendered with viewport meta
contact validation rejects bad input, accepts good
limits: Synthetic brand data; Flask file not executed here; no database, real content or deployment shown.
